parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing enforcement is severe: national policy makes sex-at-birth the controlling marker, ends X passports, triggers visa scrutiny, refusals, confiscations and possible lifetime fraud findings. Government-funded single-sex facilities exclude trans visitors, and many states/provinces criminalize facility use; an arrest and male-ward detention show operative harm. Custody reports include forced hormonal/psychiatric control, beatings and sexual abuse. Counterterrorism language frames pro-trans activism as violent. Residual employment/hate-crime protections and litigation are mostly resident-facing or partial and do not offset universal border/facility/custody exposure. No execution or near-certain death, but if outed consequences are major to catastrophic.
